evidence_items.summary: AgentEdit-Bench Agent-enhanced video editing under textual and visual underspecification AgentEdit-Bench is the video-editing benchmark introduced with Aurora: Unified Video Editing with a Tool-Using Agent (NeurIPS 2026). Its 150 cases pair a source clip with a request that leaves out something a video editor needs: a reference image for a named entity, a mask for the object to remove, or a direct statement of the edit.
